## Exceptions

EvaluationError for malformed assertion definitions or observations.

## Remarks

Errors in a composite assertion cannot become a pass through negation or an alternative. Custom evaluators receive immutable evidence snapshots. Runner-owned snapshots are shared without copying whole runs; mutable caller data remains isolated. Evaluators are explicitly injected; this function does not call any model.
